10b1ac1662bd.name: Death From Above
10b1ac1662bd.plain: During deployment, you can put this unit high in the skies instead of on the battlefield. If you do, it can arrive in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

119d6bf91fa9.name: The Raven Skull of Korvaad
119d6bf91fa9.plain: Once per turn, you can re-roll one hit roll, wound roll or damage roll for an attack made by the model with this Relic. If the model with this Relic is destroyed by an enemy unit's attack, then for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks by your RAVEN GUARD units against that enemy unit.

12506b8b627b.name: Shadowmaster
12506b8b627b.plain: Enemy units can't fire Overwatch at this Warlord.

19d34a74b3f9.name: A Deadly Prize
19d34a74b3f9.plain: At the end of your turn: pick an objective marker that is within 3" of at least one of your RAVEN GUARD INFANTRY units but not within 3" of any enemy unit. When an enemy unit next finishes a move within 3" of that marker, roll one D6: on a 2-4, it suffers D3 mortal wounds, and on a 5+, 3 mortal wounds. Each objective marker can only be picked for this Stratagem once per battle.

2717d6aabe26.name: Stealth Modified Armour
2717d6aabe26.plain: When this model is receiving the benefits of cover, add a further 1 to armour saving throws against ranged attacks allocated to it.

2bb91659797e.name: Decapitating Blow
2bb91659797e.plain: Use when one of your RAVEN GUARD units destroys an enemy WARLORD with an attack. Until the battle ends, every enemy unit has its Leadership characteristic reduced by 1.

313f98aae630.name: Master of Vigilance
313f98aae630.plain: When this Warlord attacks with a melee weapon, each unmodified hit roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any other damage.

36a5e2632f07.name: Infiltrators
36a5e2632f07.plain: At the start of the first battle round, before any turn has begun: pick one of your RAVEN GUARD INFANTRY units on the battlefield. It can make a move as though it were your Movement phase, but must finish more than 9" away from any enemy models. If each player has units that can do this, whoever takes the first turn moves their units first. No unit can be picked for this Stratagem more than once per battle.

3c2ec4262f76.name: Infiltrate, Isolate, Destroy (Aura)
3c2ec4262f76.plain: Aura: while one of your RAPTORS CORE INFANTRY units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to its charge rolls, and each time it is picked to make a Normal Move, Advance or Fall Back, add 1" to its models' Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

42d61760b7b0.name: Stranglehold
42d61760b7b0.plain: Once per battle, use at the start of the first battle round, before either player's first turn, if your army has at least one RAVEN GUARD SCOUT or RAVEN GUARD PHOBOS unit. For the rest of that battle round, each time your opponent spends Command Points on a Stratagem, you can roll one D6: on a 5+, they must spend 1 additional Command Point, or that Stratagem has no effect and can't be used again this phase (the Command Points already spent are lost).

4dca5e94bc80.name: Diving Charge
4dca5e94bc80.plain: When this model has finished a charge move, you can roll one D6 against one enemy unit in its Engagement Range: on a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

521db414067b.name: Raven's Fury
521db414067b.plain: The model with this Relic can charge in a turn in which it Advanced, can re-roll its charge rolls, and can inflict a mortal wound after charging. After that model finishes a charge move, you can pick one enemy unit within 1" of it and roll one D6: on a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Only a JUMP PACK model can take this Relic.

5dc3bb45149a.name: Malice
5dc3bb45149a.plain: Targets don't get the benefit of cover to their saving throws against attacks made with this weapon.

5e43463bc5c5.name: Token of Brotherhood
5e43463bc5c5.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate a model from a Raven Guard successor Chapter as your Warlord: one CHARACTER model in your army from a Raven Guard successor Chapter can have one Relic of the Ravenspire instead of a Special-issue Wargear Relic or a Chapter Relic. If it does, every RAVEN GUARD keyword on that Relic (if any) is swapped for that model's <CHAPTER> keyword.

61e3c432c2a0.name: The Armor of Shadows
61e3c432c2a0.plain: Weapons with AP -1 count as AP 0 when attacking the model with this Relic, and attacks against it always fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1, 2 or 3.

7337c33632ca.name: Feigned Flight
7337c33632ca.plain: This Warlord can shoot and charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and when it Falls Back it can move across models and terrain as if they weren't there.

7537ebb93f0f.name: Shadow Masters
7537ebb93f0f.plain:
Units with this tactic count as being in cover against ranged attacks from far away.
• Against a ranged attack from an attacker more than 18" away, a unit with this tactic gets the benefits of light cover.
• Against a ranged attack from an attacker more than 12" away, an INFANTRY unit with this tactic that is entirely on or within a terrain feature gets the benefits of dense cover.

784e3266e24e.name: 2) Enveloping Darkness
784e3266e24e.plain: Warp charge 7: one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this psyker can't fire Overwatch and subtracts 1 from its hit rolls. This lasts until the start of your next Psychic phase.

8d40dea8bb5d.name: 5) The Abyss
8d40dea8bb5d.plain: Warp charge 6: roll three D6 for one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to this psyker; it suffers 1 mortal wound for each 4+. If this power destroys any models in that unit, its models have 1 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic until this turn ends.

917d5a6d0b23.name: Ex Tenebris
917d5a6d0b23.plain: When picking targets for this weapon, you can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule, and you can add 1 to its hit rolls. Targets of its attacks don't get the benefit of cover to their saving throws.

930726aab29d.name: 6) The Darkness Within
930726aab29d.plain: Warp charge 6: pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" of this psyker and roll one D6 for each; on a 4+, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Add 1 to each of those rolls if the Psychic test result was more than 10.

ab6253e7ec20.name: Master of the Trifold Path
ab6253e7ec20.plain: Once per battle, after you nominate a RAVEN GUARD CHARACTER model that is not a named character as your Warlord: it can have one extra Warlord Trait, which must come from the Raven Guard Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly).

af4e1be0e38c.name: Strike from the Skies
af4e1be0e38c.plain: At the start of your Charge phase: pick one RAVEN GUARD JUMP PACK unit. Until the end of the phase, it can be chosen to charge even if it Advanced this turn, and you add 1 to its charge rolls.

b25efb2405cd.name: The Raven’s Blade
b25efb2405cd.plain: At the start of your Charge phase: pick one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the end of the phase, when you make a charge roll for one of your RAVEN GUARD units, you can re-roll it if that enemy unit was the only target picked for that charge.

b714cbba357a.name: Vengeance for Isstvan V
b714cbba357a.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your RAVEN GUARD units is chosen to fight. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit can re-roll hit rolls for attacks against WORD BEARERS, IRON WARRIORS, NIGHT LORDS or ALPHA LEGION units.

be7f0ba37f26.name: False Flight
be7f0ba37f26.plain: Use when one of your RAVEN GUARD units Falls Back. It can still shoot and charge this turn.

c12379f8cb5f.name: Rites of Battle (Aura)
c12379f8cb5f.plain: Aura: while one of your RAVEN GUARD CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

c4b87bd3de82.name: Favour of the Ravenspire
c4b87bd3de82.plain: Use before the battle: pick one of your RAVEN GUARD models with the word 'Sergeant' in its profile. Even though it is not a CHARACTER, that model can have one of these Special-issue Wargear Relics: Master-crafted Weapon, Digital Weapons, Silentus Pistol or Korvidari Bolts. Every Relic in your army must be different and on a different model.

c9ee8db5d7f3.name: Winged Deliverance (Aura)
c9ee8db5d7f3.plain: Aura: when you make a charge roll for a RAVEN GUARD JUMP PACK or RAVEN GUARD PHOBOS unit that is within 6" of this model at the time, you can re-roll it.

ce29553e4300.name: The Ebonclaws
ce29553e4300.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 2 extra attacks with this weapon, and you can re-roll wound rolls for attacks with this weapon.

ce6d4e2d747d.name: Swift and Deadly (Aura)
ce6d4e2d747d.plain: Aura: while one of your RAVEN GUARD CORE or RAVEN GUARD CHARACTER units is within 6" of this Warlord, it can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

d318d9cffd5a.name: 3) Spectral Blade
d318d9cffd5a.plain: Warp charge 5: until the start of your next Psychic phase, this psyker's Strength equals its Leadership, and its melee attacks can have AP -4. For that time, any melee weapon attack this psyker makes against a unit whose highest Leadership characteristic is lower than its own has an Armour Penetration characteristic of -4.

d52e70495931.name: 1) Umbral Form
d52e70495931.plain: Warp charge 5: this psyker gets a 4+ invulnerable save until your next Psychic phase starts.

dbed351cb146.name: Ambushing Fire
dbed351cb146.plain: Once per battle, use at the start of your Movement phase while the Tactical Doctrine is active. From then until the start of the next battle round, when one of your RAVEN GUARD models attacks with a Rapid Fire or Assault weapon and the wound roll is an unmodified 6, that weapon's Armour Penetration characteristic improves by a further 1 for that attack (so AP -1 becomes AP -2).

df0805ae0b81.name: Winged Deliverance
df0805ae0b81.plain: When you make a charge roll for a RAVEN GUARD JUMP PACK unit that is within 6" of this model at the time, you can re-roll it.

eb0b7b6867d7.name: Master of Ambush
eb0b7b6867d7.plain: At the start of the first battle round, this Warlord can redeploy one other RAVEN GUARD INFANTRY unit from your army, and itself too if it is INFANTRY. This happens before the first turn begins, and only if this Warlord is on the battlefield; the other unit must also be on the battlefield and can't be a CENTURION unit. Take that unit, and this Warlord if it is INFANTRY, off the battlefield, then place them anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from the enemy deployment zone and more than 9" away from every enemy model. If each player has abilities that redeploy units before the first turn, roll off; the winner decides which player redeploys their units first.

ecd5fa0c5d21.name: Raven's Talons
ecd5fa0c5d21.plain: Failed wound rolls for this weapon can be re-rolled.

eed5f760a700.name: Strike from the Shadows
eed5f760a700.plain: During the Declare Reserves and Transports step of your mission: pick one of your RAVEN GUARD INFANTRY units. You can place it in ambush rather than deploying it on the battlefield. If you do, it arrives at the end of any one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

f05add8caaf2.name: Oppressor's End
f05add8caaf2.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon, and attacks with this weapon against a CHARACTER unit have a Damage characteristic of 3.

f42bb3acbbfc.name: 4) Shadowstep
f42bb3acbbfc.plain: Warp charge 7: one of your RAVEN GUARD CHARACTER units within 18" of this psyker is redeployed more than 9" away from any enemy models. Take that unit off the battlefield, then set it up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy models.

f6783e9a566c.name: See, But Remain Unseen
f6783e9a566c.plain: At the end of your turn: pick one of your RAVEN GUARD units (excluding BUILDINGS) that made no attacks this turn. Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for ranged attacks that target that unit.

f985df93c9f5.name: Grim Hunter
f985df93c9f5.plain: This model can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

fe94e0797f25.name: Lay Low the Tyrants
fe94e0797f25.plain: Use when one of your RAVEN GUARD INFANTRY or RAVEN GUARD BIKER units is chosen to fight in the Fight phase. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks by that unit's models that target either a non-VEHICLE CHARACTER unit, or a non-VEHICLE unit containing any models with a Wounds characteristic of 4 or more.
